world_model_delta: Conquest reversal: a successful conquest may be challenged within 5 turns via a COUNTER_CONQUEST declaration. Rules are identical to initial conquest. After 5 turns, ownership is stable until next conquest. No retroactive claim exists outside the challenge window. The challenge window is mechanical, not a governance appeals period.
validator_question: Does the 5-turn challenge window create a governance-like appeals period?
risk_of_symbol_smuggling: MEDIUM — challenge window resembles appeals period; explicit: counter-conquest is mechanical only, no governance tribunal
